The Witcher 1 came out in 2007 for PC, it was developed by CD Project Red and publish by both Atari and CD Project Red. The game is a third person adventure RPG game. I bought this game and Steam sale for $1, with no sale the game is $10 on Steam and GOG. The game is based on the book series The Witcher.

The Witcher starts off with Geralt losing his memory awakening at Kaer Morhen, shortly afterwards Kaer Morhen comes under attack by Salamandra which steals the Witcher's secrets mutagenic substances and stimulants. Geralt sets out to recover his memory, the Witcher's secrets and to take out Salamandra. Overall the story in this game is great and is worth the playthrough alone. Most conversations with NPC's are pretty good and interesting while some are absolutely hilarious, special moments with Dandelion and Zoltan.

The gameplay is your standard point and click RPG with a few actions buttons, once you click on an enemy to fight them your mouse arrow will flash, clicking the flash will allow bigger combos and critical hits. Double tapping your movement keys allow you to quickly dodge. Over the course of the game you'll also learn how to make potions, mutagens, and magic spells to add to your combat. It is kinda of your generic action RPG but still manages to be it's own thing. This is also the first PC game I played on mouse and key board that wasn't a Sims or RTS game.

Graphical wise the game is outdated and you may not recognize some of the characters in the later games of the series. However, some of the small details this game impress me, for example you'll see your reflection in the mirrors and your medallion on your upper left hand screen will have shadow effects on it depending how your facing the light.

Overall I really enjoyed the game, it was great and fun to play. The story was great too and is a good start into the Witcher series. For a game that is older is still and great game to I got about 43hrs of gameplay in to beat it, I can't really think of anything with the game I didn't like. I give this game a 10/10, I say it's worth the $10 price or you can pick it up cheaper on the next Steam or GOG sale. Thank you for reading
